options.name: Secession of Ila Heksareksoi
options.desc: In the aftermath of the Second War of Hegemony, the Isle of Six Kings has seceeded and functions as an independent entity with little ties to Graonia.

options.name: Ila Heksareksoi partnership
options.desc: The country has signed bilateral agreements with the Isle of Six Kings, including a free-trade zone and mutual diplomatic support clause.

options.name: Ila Heksareksoi re-integration
options.desc: The Isle of Six Kings is a part of Graonia once more.
